insert.title: Leaning Lateral Raise (Cable)
insert.search_terms: side delt deltoid cable lean away
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable pulley at the lowest position with a single handle.
2. Stand sideways to the stack, hold the handle with the far hand, and grab the stack or an upright with the other hand to lean away from it.
3. Raise your arm out to the side until it is about shoulder height, leading with the elbow.
4. Lower slowly so the cable stays under tension. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
insert.search_terms: pulldown close parallel grip v bar back
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a neutral-grip (parallel handle) bar to a high pulley and sit with your thighs secured under the pads.
2. Grab the handles with your palms facing each other and lean back slightly.
3. Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
4. Pause, then let your arms rise slowly until your lats are fully stretched.

insert.title: High-Bar Back Squat (Barbell)
insert.search_terms: squats legs rack high bar olympic
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper traps, high on your back, grip it just outside your shoulders and step back from the rack with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit down between your hips until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
4. Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

insert.title: Standing Hip Extension (Cable)
insert.search_terms: glute kickback ankle strap cable
insert.instructions:
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
2. Face the stack and hold the frame for balance, with a slight bend in your standing knee.
3. Keeping your torso upright, push the strapped leg back and up by squeezing your glute.
4. Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press (Cable)
insert.search_terms: anti rotation core abs half kneel
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at chest height with a handle and kneel sideways to the stack, with the inside knee down and the outside foot forward.
2. Hold the handle against your chest with both hands and brace your abs.
3. Press the handle straight out until your arms are fully extended, resisting the pull to rotate.
4. Hold for a moment, bring it back to your chest, and repeat. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Shoulder External Rotation (Cable)
insert.search_terms: rotator cuff infraspinatus rear delt kneel
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable handle at elbow height and kneel sideways to the stack, with the knee nearest it down.
2. Hold the handle with the far hand and tuck your elbow against your side at a right angle.
3. Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow still.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Cuban Press (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: rotator cuff upright row external rotation light
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Row the dumbbells up to chest height with your elbows leading, keeping them high.
3. Rotate your forearms up until your hands point toward the ceiling, then press overhead.
4. Reverse the movement under control back to the start.

insert.title: Pin Press (Barbell)
insert.search_terms: bench pin lockout rack dead stop
insert.instructions:
1. Set the safety pins in a rack at the height you want to press from, and lie on a bench under the bar.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and press it off the pins.
3. Lower the bar to the pins and let it rest there, keeping your shoulder blades pinned back.
4. Press the bar back up from the dead stop.

insert.title: Incline Powell Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: rear delt chest supported incline bench lateral raise
insert.instructions:
1. Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang with your palms facing each other.
3. Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they are level with your shoulders.
4. Lower slowly. Keep your torso against the bench throughout.

insert.title: Poliquin Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: side delt lateral raise thumbs up
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Raise your arms out to the sides with your elbows slightly bent and your thumbs pointing up.
3. Stop when your hands reach shoulder height, then lower slowly.
4. Keep your torso still and avoid swinging the weights.

insert.title: Prone Y Raise
insert.search_terms: lower trap scapular bodyweight floor
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended overhead in a Y shape and your thumbs pointing up.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back to lift your arms off the floor.
3. Hold for a moment at the top, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Prone Single-Arm Trap Raise
insert.search_terms: prone trap raise lower trap scapular warm up
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down on a bench or the floor with one arm hanging down or extended overhead, thumb up.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blade down and back to raise the arm, keeping your elbow straight.
3. Hold for a moment, then lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Skater Squat
insert.search_terms: single leg squat bodyweight rear foot back
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg with your other knee bent and your foot off the floor behind you.
2. Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg until your rear knee lightly touches the floor.
3. Keep your chest up and your standing knee in line with your toes.
4. Drive through your whole foot to stand. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Jefferson Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: spinal flexion mobility hinge light
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a low box or stable surface holding a light dumbbell in front of your thighs.
2. Tuck your chin and roll your spine down one vertebra at a time, letting the weight travel toward your toes.
3. Go as far as your hamstrings allow, then reverse, rolling back up from your hips to your head.
4. Use a light load and move slowly.

insert.title: Weighted Dead Bug (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: core abs anti extension weighted
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with both hands, and lift your knees to a 90-degree angle.
2. Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
3. Slowly extend one leg away from you while keeping the dumbbell steady.
4. Return and extend the other leg. Alternate sides.

insert.title: Scapula Push-Up
insert.search_terms: serratus protraction shoulder blade push up
insert.instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with your arms straight and your hands under your shoulders.
2. Keeping your elbows locked, let your chest sink between your shoulder blades.
3. Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart and round your upper back slightly.
4. Repeat with small, controlled movements.

insert.title: Snatch-Grip Shrug (Barbell)
insert.search_terms: wide grip shrugs olympic trap
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding a barbell with a very wide snatch-width grip, arms straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, then pause.
4. Lower slowly without bending your elbows.

insert.title: Kneeling Leaning Single-Arm Row (Cable)
insert.search_terms: one arm row kneel lean lat stretch
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable pulley at the lowest position with a single handle and kneel facing the stack.
2. Hold the handle in one hand and lean your torso forward, bracing the other hand on a bench or your thigh.
3. Pull the handle toward your hip, driving your elbow back.
4. Let your arm extend fully to stretch the lat. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Tate Press (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: tricep elbows out lying extension
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing your feet.
2. Flare your elbows out and lower the dumbbells until they touch your chest.
3. Keep your upper arms still and extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
4. Do not let your elbows drift toward your head.

insert.title: World's Greatest Stretch
insert.search_terms: mobility warm up lunge thoracic rotation hip
insert.instructions:
1. Step into a deep lunge and place both hands inside your front foot.
2. Drop your back knee or keep it lifted, and sink your hips toward the floor.
3. Rotate your torso toward the front leg and reach that arm up to the ceiling.
4. Return your hand to the floor, switch legs, and repeat.

insert.title: Pigeon Pose
insert.search_terms: hip stretch glute external rotation mobility
insert.instructions:
1. From all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist and extend the other leg straight back.
2. Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your torso upright.
3. Fold forward over the front shin to deepen the stretch.
4. Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.

insert.title: Half Pigeon Stretch
insert.search_terms: hip stretch glute external rotation mobility
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other extended behind.
2. Keep your hips level and lean forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch in your glute.
3. Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.

insert.title: Forearm Wall Slide
insert.search_terms: mobility shoulder wall forearm scapular
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a wall with your forearms and the backs of your hands flat against it, elbows at shoulder height.
2. Slide your forearms up the wall as high as you can while keeping them in contact.
3. Slide them back down slowly. Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

insert.title: Serratus Wall Slide
insert.search_terms: serratus anterior scapular upward rotation mobility shoulder
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a wall with your forearms against it, elbows at shoulder height and a small bend at the wrists.
2. Press your forearms into the wall and slide them up while reaching your arms overhead.
3. Push your shoulder blades around your ribs as you reach, then slide back down slowly.

insert.title: Thread the Needle
insert.search_terms: thoracic rotation mobility all fours shoulder
insert.instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
2. Slide one arm under your body, palm up, until your shoulder and the side of your head rest on the floor.
3. Hold for a breath, then unwind and reach that arm up to the ceiling.
4. Repeat, then switch sides.

insert.title: Across-Chest Shoulder Stretch
insert.search_terms: cross body shoulder stretch rear delt
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
2. Hold it just above the elbow with your other hand and pull it gently toward you.
3. Keep your shoulders down and relaxed. Hold, then switch arms.

insert.title: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
insert.search_terms: half kneeling lunge stretch psoas mobility
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on one knee with your other foot flat on the floor in front of you, on a pad if needed.
2. Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
3. Shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip. Keep your torso upright.
4. Hold, then switch sides.

insert.title: Cat-Cow
insert.search_terms: spinal mobility warm up cat camel back all fours
insert.instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
2. Breathe in and let your belly drop as you lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
3. Breathe out and round your back toward the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat).
4. Move slowly between the two positions.

insert.title: Thoracic Open Book
insert.search_terms: thoracic rotation side lying mobility spine
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent at 90 degrees and your arms straight out in front of you, palms together.
2. Keep your knees stacked and rotate your top arm up and back, following it with your eyes, until your chest faces the ceiling.
3. Return slowly to the start. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: 90/90 Hip Stretch
insert.search_terms: hip rotation mobility internal external 90 90
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your front knee bent at 90 degrees in front of you and your back knee bent at 90 degrees to the side.
2. Sit tall and lean your torso over the front shin until you feel the stretch in your outer hip.
3. Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.

insert.title: Couch Stretch
insert.search_terms: hip flexor quad stretch kneeling wall mobility
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel with the shin of one leg up a wall or couch behind you and your other foot flat on the floor in front.
2. Squeeze your glute on the back leg and tuck your pelvis under.
3. Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch along the front of the hip and thigh.
4. Hold, then switch sides.

insert.title: Doorway Pec Stretch
insert.search_terms: chest stretch door frame pectoral
insert.instructions:
1. Stand in a doorway and place your forearm on the frame with your elbow at shoulder height.
2. Step through slightly with the same-side foot until you feel a stretch across your chest.
3. Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed. Hold, then switch sides.

insert.title: Seated Hamstring Stretch
insert.search_terms: hamstring stretch seated toe reach
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other foot against your inner thigh.
2. Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back and reach toward your toes.
3. Hold when you feel a stretch behind your thigh, then switch legs.

insert.title: Standing Calf Stretch
insert.search_terms: calf stretch wall gastrocnemius
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a wall with your hands against it and one foot a step behind the other.
2. Keep the back leg straight and press its heel into the floor.
3. Lean forward until you feel the stretch in your calf. Hold, then switch legs.

insert.title: Child's Pose
insert.search_terms: lat stretch lower back yoga kneeling rest
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and your knees apart.
2. Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward along the floor.
3. Rest your forehead down and breathe slowly. Hold.

insert.title: Front-to-Back Leg Swing
insert.search_terms: leg swings dynamic warm up hip mobility
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall and hold a wall or rack for balance.
2. Swing one leg forward and back in a smooth arc, keeping your torso upright.
3. Increase the range gradually. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Side-to-Side Leg Swing
insert.search_terms: leg swings dynamic warm up hip mobility adductor
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a wall and hold it for balance.
2. Swing one leg across your body and then out to the side in a smooth arc, keeping your hips square.
3. Increase the range gradually. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Standing Glute Squeeze
insert.search_terms: glute activation warm up bodyweight
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed.
2. Squeeze your glutes as hard as you can without arching your lower back.
3. Hold for a second or two, release, and repeat.

insert.title: Copenhagen Plank
insert.search_terms: adductor side plank groin bench
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your top foot on a bench and your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
2. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
3. Lift the bottom leg up to meet the top leg, or let it hang below the bench.
4. Hold, then switch sides.

insert.title: Reverse Nordic Curl
insert.search_terms: reverse nordic quad knee extension kneeling lean back
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on a pad with your hips extended and your torso upright, and brace your abs.
2. Lean back slowly as far as you can control, keeping a straight line from knees to head.
3. Pull yourself back up using your quads.

insert.title: Spanish Squat (Band)
insert.search_terms: spanish squat isometric knee patellar tendon band
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a heavy band behind you at knee height and loop it around the backs of your knees.
2. Step away until the band is tight and lean back, with your torso upright and your shins vertical.
3. Sit into a squat position and hold it, keeping the load in your quads.

insert.title: Squat (Safety Bar)
insert.search_terms: safety squat bar ssb squats
insert.instructions:
1. Set a safety squat bar on your shoulders and step back from the rack with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the handles, brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Sit down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
4. Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

insert.title: Kelso Shrug (Barbell)
insert.search_terms: chest supported shrug scapular retraction mid trap
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a barbell hanging at arm's length.
2. Keep your arms straight and pull your shoulder blades together toward your spine.
3. Pause at the top, then lower slowly until your shoulder blades spread apart.

insert.title: Lu Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: lateral raise overhead lu xiaojun side delt
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, then keep going in a wide arc until they are overhead.
3. Lower back down through the same arc, slowly and under control.
4. Use a light load.

insert.title: Kroc Row (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: heavy one arm row high rep dumbbell back
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with one hand and the same-side knee braced on a bench, and a heavy dumbbell in your other hand.
2. Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, allowing a small amount of body English.
3. Lower it until your arm is fully stretched. Finish a high-rep set, then switch sides.

insert.title: Helms Row (Dumbbell)
insert.search_terms: chest supported row incline bench elbows out
insert.instructions:
1. Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang straight down, then row the dumbbells up with your elbows at about 45 degrees from your torso.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
4. Lower slowly to a full stretch.

insert.title: Spoto Press (Barbell)
insert.search_terms: bench press pause chest pause above chest sling shot
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench and unrack the bar over your chest with your shoulder blades pinned back.
2. Lower the bar until it stops about an inch above your chest, without touching.
3. Hold that position for a second, then press back up.
